sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The series on Jonestown deals with horrific events.
sentences.zh: 关于琼斯镇的系列节目涉及一些骇人听闻的事件。

sentences.en: The series deals with mass murder and suicide of men, women and children, as well as other abuses.
sentences.zh: 该系列讲述了针对男女老少的集体谋杀与自杀，以及其他虐待行为。

sentences.en: The episodes are graphic and distressing, especially episode 3.
sentences.zh: 剧集内容生动且令人不安，尤其是第三集。

sentences.en: It will not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 并非所有听众都适合收听。

sentences.en: Please use your discretion.
sentences.zh: 请自行斟酌。

sentences.en: The tropical country of Guyana is located on the northern mainland of South America.
sentences.zh: 圭亚那是一个热带国家，位于南美洲大陆北部。

sentences.en: Guyana features a variety of striking natural landscapes.
sentences.zh: 圭亚那拥有多种引人注目的自然景观。

sentences.en: Spectacular volcanic escarpments, rivers, botanical gardens, rainforests and waterfalls are hidden throughout.
sentences.zh: 壮观的火山悬崖、河流、植物园、雨林和瀑布隐藏在各地。

sentences.en: Colourful and exotic animals such as flamingos, iguanas, parrots, toucans can be found in the dense jungles.
sentences.zh: 在茂密的丛林中，可以见到火烈鸟、鬣蜥、鹦鹉、巨嘴鸟等色彩斑斓的珍禽异兽。

sentences.en: Guyana is raw beauty.
sentences.zh: 圭亚那拥有原始之美。

sentences.en: Vibrant and expansive.
sentences.zh: 充满活力且广袤无垠。

sentences.en: Guyana's motto is one people, one nation, one destiny.
sentences.zh: 圭亚那的格言是：一个民族，一个国家，一个命运。

sentences.en: It was the only English-speaking country in South America, and was a cooperative socialist republic.
sentences.zh: 它是南美洲唯一的英语国家，也是一个合作社会主义共和国。

sentences.en: For those reasons, Guyana caught the eye of Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 正因这些原因，圭亚那吸引了吉姆·琼斯的目光。

sentences.en: Jones perceived the United States as racist and oppressive, and he wanted to create a self-sustaining, remote commune
sentences.zh: 琼斯认为美国种族主义盛行且充满压迫，他想建立一个自给自足的偏远公社，

sentences.en: for his thousands of followers to immigrate to and permanently live in.
sentences.zh: 供他数千名追随者移民并永久居住。

sentences.en: It would be a benevolent, multiracial, socialist paradise, where everything was owned and shared by the community as a whole.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个仁慈、多种族、社会主义的乐园，一切都由社区集体所有并共享。

sentences.en: In 1974, People's Temple negotiated with Guyana's government to develop approximately 4,000 acres of land.
sentences.zh: 1974年，“人民圣殿教”与圭亚那政府协商，开发了约4000英亩土地。

sentences.en: By 1976, an official 25-year land lease was signed.
sentences.zh: 到1976年，双方正式签署了一份为期25年的土地租赁协议。

sentences.en: People's Temple were to pay roughly $1,000 annually to the Guyana government for the chosen land.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教每年需向圭亚那政府支付约1000美元的租金。

sentences.en: An isolated area of jungle along the Venezuelan border was chosen for Jim Jones' socialist community,
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉边境沿线的一片偏远丛林被选为吉姆·琼斯的社会主义社区所在地，

sentences.en: Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 即琼斯镇。

sentences.en: Two years before the lease was signed,
sentences.zh: 在签署租约的两年前，

sentences.en: 15 People's Temple members set out to Guyana to prepare for the construction of the commune.
sentences.zh: 15名人民圣殿教成员前往圭亚那，为公社的建设做准备。

sentences.en: They set sail from Miami in July 1974.
sentences.zh: 他们于1974年7月从迈阿密启航。

sentences.en: It took 10 days to cross the Atlantic Ocean between North and South America.
sentences.zh: 横跨南北美洲之间的大西洋耗时10天。

sentences.en: The ocean lapped, pummeled, and almost swallowed the trawler.
sentences.zh: 海浪拍打、冲击着拖网渔船，几乎将其吞没。

sentences.en: The windshield cracked, the rudder snapped, and cargo fell overboard.
sentences.zh: 挡风玻璃碎裂，舵杆折断，货物落入海中。

sentences.en: But the sea-battered People's Temple travellers managed to reach Guyana's coastal capital city,
sentences.zh: 但这些饱受海浪摧残的人民圣殿教成员最终抵达了圭亚那的沿海首都，

sentences.en: Georgetown.
sentences.zh: 乔治敦。

sentences.en: They purchased a spacious two-storey building in an upscale area of Georgetown, which became Temple headquarters.
sentences.zh: 他们在乔治敦的高档区买下了一栋宽敞的两层建筑，作为圣殿总部。

sentences.en: The People's Temple pioneers then piled back onto their trawler and sailed up the Waini River, before steering down the Kytuma River.
sentences.zh: 随后，人民圣殿教的先驱们又挤回拖网渔船，沿怀尼河航行，随后转入凯图马河。

sentences.en: The Kytuma River snaked through the foggy rainforest and led the trawler to its final destination,
sentences.zh: 凯图马河蜿蜒穿过雾气缭绕的雨林，将拖网渔船引向最终目的地，

sentences.en: Port Kytuma.
sentences.zh: 凯图马港。

sentences.en: The harsh reality of the Third World Nation hit when they arrived at the riverside village of Port Kytuma.
sentences.zh: 当他们抵达凯图马港这个河畔村庄时，第三世界国家的残酷现实扑面而来。

sentences.en: Slums of shanty homes made from mismatched timber with corrugated iron roofs lined the streets.
sentences.zh: 街道两旁是贫民窟，棚屋由拼凑的木材建成，屋顶铺着波纹铁皮。

sentences.en: Residents suffered from disease and malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 居民们饱受疾病和营养不良的折磨。

sentences.en: Children's bodies were swollen, sweaty, and covered in sores.
sentences.zh: 孩子们身体浮肿、汗流浃背，身上布满疮口。

sentences.en: Dead animals rot in trenches of mosquito-infested water on the side of swampy red clay roads.
sentences.zh: 沼泽般的红土路边，死去的动物在蚊虫滋生的水沟里腐烂。

sentences.en: The humid air felt oily and tasted burnt.
sentences.zh: 潮湿的空气中弥漫着油腻感，尝起来有股焦味。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the People's Temple pioneers were determined.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，人民圣殿教的先驱们依然意志坚定。

sentences.en: Each day they'd wake early, pile into flatbed trucks, and drive six miles down the pothole clay road to where their commune was to be established.
sentences.zh: 他们每天早起，挤上平板卡车，沿着坑坑洼洼的土路行驶六英里，前往他们计划建立公社的地方。

sentences.en: What started as a single footpath through the jungle was cut away by hand using axes, cutlasses, and machetes.
sentences.zh: 最初丛林中只有一条人行小径，他们用斧头、砍刀和弯刀手工开辟出道路。

sentences.en: It was hard, back-breaking work.
sentences.zh: 那是艰苦且累人的体力活。

sentences.en: The jungle was unspoiled and inaccessible.
sentences.zh: 丛林原始且难以进入。

sentences.en: Mike Touche, an early People's Temple settler in Guyana,
sentences.zh: 迈克·图什，圭亚那早期的人民圣殿教定居者，

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：

sentences.en: Living down there was hard, heavy work, mostly with your hands and your back, but with the additional challenges of the jungle thrown in, like the heat, the rain, and the bugs.
sentences.zh: 在那里生活是艰苦的重体力活，主要靠双手和背部，还要面对丛林带来的额外挑战，比如酷热、暴雨和虫子。

sentences.en: We were also isolated from everything and everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们还与世隔绝，远离一切人和事。

sentences.en: If we needed a piece of equipment, we couldn't go down to a local supply store.
sentences.zh: 如果我们需要一件设备，没法去当地的供应店买。

sentences.en: We had to fashion it ourselves, or wait for weeks while the order came in from Georgetown, or even further away.
sentences.zh: 我们必须自己动手制作，或者等待数周，等订单从乔治敦甚至更远的地方运来。

sentences.en: Or do without.
sentences.zh: 或者干脆不用。

sentences.en: You had to have a pioneering spirit to survive.
sentences.zh: 你必须具备开拓精神才能生存。

sentences.en: A bulldozer and backhoe were eventually shipped over from the United States, allowing walls of jungle to be torn down with ease.
sentences.zh: 最终，一台推土机和一台挖掘机从美国运抵，使得丛林墙壁可以轻松被推倒。

sentences.en: The foundations of the first buildings were laid, and fields were tilled in preparation for crops.
sentences.zh: 第一批建筑的地基打好了，田地也被耕耘，为农作物种植做准备。

sentences.en: The commune was formally named
sentences.zh: 该公社被正式命名为

sentences.en: The People's Temple Agricultural Project.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教农业项目。

sentences.en: The People's Temple Agricultural Project population grew slowly at first, housing just 50 residents in the first few months.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教农业项目的人口起初增长缓慢，头几个月仅容纳了50名居民。

sentences.en: Despite the difficulties of the foreign landscape and tropical climate, hope remained high as chosen temple members made their pilgrimage from the United States to Guyana.
sentences.zh: 尽管面临异国地貌和热带气候的困难，但随着选定的圣殿成员从美国前往圭亚那朝圣，人们依然保持着高度的希望。

sentences.en: Their jungle paradise was referred to as the Promised Land, or Freedom Land.
sentences.zh: 他们的丛林天堂被称为“应许之地”或“自由之地”。

sentences.en: But most called it Jonestown, after their leader, Reverend Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人根据他们的领袖吉姆·琼斯牧师的名字，称其为琼斯镇。

sentences.en: The success of Jonestown relied on the determination and motivation of its residents.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的成功依赖于居民们的决心和动力。

sentences.en: Most were born and raised in America's cities, and few had farming or laboring experience.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人在美国的城市出生长大，几乎没有人有务农或劳动的经验。

sentences.en: Mike Touche, quote,
sentences.zh: 迈克·图什说：

sentences.en: After a satisfying breakfast of eggs with biscuits, pastries and coffee, laborers headed to the fields and planted and harvested crops,
sentences.zh: 在享用过鸡蛋、饼干、糕点和咖啡的丰盛早餐后，工人们前往田间播种和收获庄稼，

sentences.en: tended to livestock, and laid down foundations for more buildings.
sentences.zh: 照料牲畜，并为更多建筑打下地基。

sentences.en: The furniture department built beds, cabinets, and cribs.
sentences.zh: 家具部门制作了床、柜子和婴儿床。

sentences.en: The sawmill produced the frames for residents' homes.
sentences.zh: 锯木厂生产了居民房屋的框架。

sentences.en: A medical clinic was also established.
sentences.zh: 还建立了一个医疗诊所。

sentences.en: At lunchtime, everyone took a break to eat a sandwich and relax.
sentences.zh: 午餐时间，大家休息片刻，吃个三明治放松一下。

sentences.en: Elderly residents sorted, cleaned, and prepared vegetables for dinner.
sentences.zh: 老年居民负责分拣、清洗和准备晚餐用的蔬菜。

sentences.en: Dinner was either a plate of fried chicken or fish, with green vegetables on the side, and peanut butter fudge for dessert.
sentences.zh: 晚餐通常是一盘炸鸡或鱼，配上绿色蔬菜，甜点是花生酱软糖。

sentences.en: After dinner, the early settlers met in the pavilion in the centre of the commune.
sentences.zh: 晚餐后，早期定居者会在公社中心的凉亭集合。

sentences.en: The pavilion was a large, open-air structure, with a corrugated iron roof set on wooden columns.
sentences.zh: 凉亭是一个大型露天建筑，木柱支撑着波纹铁皮屋顶。

sentences.en: Used as a central meeting area, it featured a stage at one end, with multiple benches and chairs in front.
sentences.zh: 作为中心会议区，它的一端设有舞台，前方摆放着多排长椅和椅子。

sentences.en: Signs with slogans such as Love One Another were featured within.
sentences.zh: 里面挂着写有“彼此相爱”等口号的标语牌。

sentences.en: At night, it was a hub of social activity.
sentences.zh: 夜晚，这里是社交活动的中心。

sentences.en: Elderly residents played dominoes and cards.
sentences.zh: 老年居民玩多米诺骨牌和纸牌。

sentences.en: Children watched movies and television.
sentences.zh: 孩子们看电影和电视。

sentences.en: Teenagers listened and danced to music.
sentences.zh: 青少年听音乐跳舞。

sentences.en: And couples snuck away for privacy.
sentences.zh: 情侣们则溜出去寻找私密空间。

sentences.en: Preparation to send more People's Temple members to Guyana took months.
sentences.zh: 准备派遣更多人民圣殿教成员前往圭亚那耗时数月。

sentences.en: Passports, visas, and immunisations were needed.
sentences.zh: 需要准备护照、签证和疫苗接种。

sentences.en: In the United States, apartments were vacated, homes sold, bank accounts closed, and jobs quit.
sentences.zh: 在美国，公寓被腾空，房屋被出售，银行账户被注销，工作被辞掉。

sentences.en: Population influxes were gradual, so as to not overwhelm the commune, and to give new settlers time to prepare.
sentences.zh: 人口流入是循序渐进的，以免公社不堪重负，并给新定居者留出准备时间。

sentences.en: By May 1976, there were approximately 100 Temple members living in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 到1976年5月，约有100名圣殿成员居住在琼斯镇。

sentences.en: These early days of Jonestown were filled with optimism and positivity.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的早期日子里充满了乐观和积极情绪。

sentences.en: A shortwave radio was built in the commune to communicate with People's Temple headquarters in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 公社内建造了一台短波电台，用于与旧金山的人民圣殿教总部进行通讯。

sentences.en: Positive updates about the jungle commune were relayed to Temple members still living in America.
sentences.zh: 关于丛林公社的积极消息被传达给仍在美国的圣殿成员。

sentences.en: By April 77, almost three years since the first pioneers arrived in Guyana, there were 400 Temple residents living in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 到1977年4月，距离第一批先驱抵达圭亚那已近三年，琼斯镇已有400名圣殿居民。

sentences.en: The commune had become an impressive township.
sentences.zh: 公社已经发展成一个令人印象深刻的城镇。

sentences.en: Beyond the entrance into Jonestown were six cottages for senior residents.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇入口处有六间供老年居民居住的小屋。

sentences.en: Amongst these homes were a doctor's office, an infirmary, a laboratory, and a pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 在这些住宅中，还有医生办公室、医务室、实验室和药房。

sentences.en: Further along was the dining tent, kitchen, bakery, and a stand full of hanging bananas of various shades of green.
sentences.zh: 再往前走是餐厅帐篷、厨房、面包房，以及一个挂满各种绿色香蕉的摊位。

sentences.en: There was a vegetable stand for storing, sorting, and preparing fresh food and herbs, as well as a smokehouse, and a sunken cellar door.
sentences.zh: 还有一个用于储存、分拣和准备新鲜食物及草药的蔬菜摊，以及一个熏制房和一个下沉式地窖门。

sentences.en: A laundry was built behind the cooking area where the heat from the kitchen was used to dry damp clothes.
sentences.zh: 烹饪区后面建了一个洗衣房，利用厨房的热量烘干潮湿的衣物。

sentences.en: At the end of the main road was the tool shop, garage, sawmill, supply storage, fuel tank, and a warehouse.
sentences.zh: 主路尽头是工具房、车库、锯木厂、物资仓库、油箱和货仓。

sentences.en: A dirt footpath snaking from the main road led to Westhouse.
sentences.zh: 一条从主路蜿蜒而出的土路通往“西屋”。

sentences.en: This was where People's Temple's senior leadership and staff stayed during visits.
sentences.zh: 这是人民圣殿教高层领导和工作人员访问期间的住所。

sentences.en: It was larger than all other residential structures in the commune.
sentences.zh: 它比公社里所有的其他住宅建筑都要大。

sentences.en: In the centre of the commune was the main pavilion, and adjacent to that was the radio room.
sentences.zh: 公社中心是主凉亭，旁边是无线电室。

sentences.en: Next to the radio room were two educational tents, and a library where school classes were held for children.
sentences.zh: 无线电室旁边有两个教育帐篷和一个图书馆，供孩子们上课使用。

sentences.en: There was also a playground and a basketball court.
sentences.zh: 还有一个操场和一个篮球场。

sentences.en: A dormitory was used as a nursery for toddlers and preschool children.
sentences.zh: 一间宿舍被用作幼儿和学龄前儿童的托儿所。

sentences.en: Another was used as an animal refuge.
sentences.zh: 另一间被用作动物收容所。

sentences.en: Beyond these dormitories, the path forked in two directions.
sentences.zh: 穿过这些宿舍，小路分成了两条。

sentences.en: To the left were several cottages known as Easthouse, where outside visitors stayed.
sentences.zh: 左边是几间被称为“东屋”的小屋，供外来访客居住。

sentences.en: The second path led to 48 pastel-coloured cottages, where Jonestown's adults slept.
sentences.zh: 第二条路通往48间柔和色调的小屋，那是琼斯镇成年人的住所。

sentences.en: Overlooking the cottages was a guard tower.
sentences.zh: 小屋上方俯瞰着一座岗楼。

sentences.en: It had children's slides installed at the slowest level, and a wind-driven generator at its top.
sentences.zh: 它在最低层安装了儿童滑梯，顶部装有风力发电机。

sentences.en: Bathrooms and showering facilities were nearby.
sentences.zh: 附近有浴室和淋浴设施。

sentences.en: The toilets were built over a pit, and the toilet seat was a long bench with six oval holes.
sentences.zh: 厕所建在坑上，马桶座是一个带有六个椭圆孔的长凳。

sentences.en: Generated buildings and numerous wells and windmills were located throughout the commune.
sentences.zh: 公社各处分布着发电机房、多口水井和风车。

sentences.en: Further away were the piggery, barns, and a chicken coop, and cultivated fields and orchards full of planted crops surrounded the commune's edges.
sentences.zh: 更远的地方是猪圈、谷仓和鸡舍，公社边缘环绕着耕种的田地和果园。

sentences.en: Reverend Jim Jones visited his commune throughout its progress.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯牧师在公社发展的过程中多次到访。

sentences.en: When Jones came to town, residents were tense and irritable.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯来到镇上时，居民们会感到紧张和烦躁。

sentences.en: In America, temple members sunk years, money, and energy into people's temple.
sentences.zh: 在美国，圣殿成员在人民圣殿教上投入了多年的时间、金钱和精力。

sentences.en: They were rewarded with long work hours, violent punishments, public humiliations, social isolation, and blackmail.
sentences.zh: 他们得到的回报却是长时间的工作、暴力惩罚、公开羞辱、社会孤立和勒索。

sentences.en: The negativity corrupted the purpose of the temple, to bring equality through socialism.
sentences.zh: 这种负面情绪腐蚀了圣殿通过社会主义实现平等的宗旨。

sentences.en: Once a compassionate leader, Jim Jones transformed into a paranoid drug abuser, sexual predator, and egotistical tyrant.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯曾是一位富有同情心的领袖，后来却变成了一个偏执的吸毒者、性掠夺者和自负的暴君。

sentences.en: As temple life in America spiraled into one of cruelty and control, temple life in Jonestown without Jones was a relaxed atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 当美国的圣殿生活陷入残酷与控制的漩涡时，没有琼斯的琼斯镇生活氛围却很轻松。

sentences.en: Jonestown resident Eugene Smith, quote,
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇居民尤金·史密斯说：

sentences.en: When Jim Jones wasn't there, things tended to be a little bit lighter.
sentences.zh: 当吉姆·琼斯不在的时候，事情往往会轻松一些。

sentences.en: People would be dancing or singing.
sentences.zh: 人们会跳舞或唱歌。

sentences.en: There'd be music in different cottages.
sentences.zh: 不同的小屋里会传出音乐声。

sentences.en: But when Jones was present, it was very, very dark.
sentences.zh: 但当琼斯在场时，气氛会变得非常、非常压抑。

sentences.en: It was almost like a dark cloud.
sentences.zh: 就像有一片乌云笼罩。

sentences.en: Jones filmed one of his visits, and the footage was spliced together by People's Temple PR teams to relay an image of the commune that was favourable, but not truthful.
sentences.zh: 琼斯拍摄了其中一次访问，这些片段被人民圣殿教的公关团队剪辑在一起，以传达一种有利但并不真实的公社形象。

sentences.en: The PR videos featured panning footage of the large agricultural fields lined with growing fruits and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 公关视频展示了种满水果和蔬菜的大片农田的平移镜头。

sentences.en: But they didn't show that most crops failed to reach harvest due to unpredictable weather, pests, and poor soil.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有展示大多数农作物因天气不可预测、虫害和土壤贫瘠而无法收获的事实。

sentences.en: Fruit trees took years to grow and produce, so they provided no immediate sustenance.
sentences.zh: 果树需要多年才能生长和结果，因此无法提供即时的食物来源。

sentences.en: The videos featured close-ups of satisfying meals consisting of bacon, barbecued ribs, sausages, and fried chicken.
sentences.zh: 视频中展示了由培根、烤排骨、香肠和炸鸡组成的丰盛餐点的特写镜头。

sentences.en: However, cows, pigs, and chickens were dying from a mysterious illness, and meat had become a rare ingredient on Jonestown's menu.
sentences.zh: 然而，牛、猪和鸡正死于一种神秘的疾病，肉类已成为琼斯镇菜单上稀有的配料。

sentences.en: Jones toured the chicken coops on camera and lied about there being thousands of chickens in the commune, and that none of them had ever died, calling it a miracle of miracles.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在镜头前参观鸡舍，谎称公社里有数千只鸡，而且一只都没死过，称其为奇迹中的奇迹。

sentences.en: Residential cottages were shown in impeccable condition, with only two bunk beds featured in each.
sentences.zh: 住宅小屋被展示为状况完美，每间只放了两张双层床。

sentences.en: In reality, cottages were overcrowded because homes were not going up as fast as new residents were arriving.
sentences.zh: 实际上，小屋非常拥挤，因为房屋的建造速度赶不上新居民的到来。

sentences.en: By mid-1977, there were already more people in Jonestown than the land could support.
sentences.zh: 到1977年中期，琼斯镇的人口已经超过了土地所能承载的极限。

sentences.en: Jonestown residents were unaware of the bad news unravelling in America.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的居民并不知道美国正在发生的不利消息。

sentences.en: On August 1st, 1977, New West magazine published an article titled Inside People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 1977年8月1日，《新西部》杂志发表了一篇题为《走进人民圣殿教》的文章。

sentences.en: The article featured testimony of ex-Temple members who exposed Jim Jones as a possessive and violent fraud.
sentences.zh: 文章刊登了前圣殿成员的证词，揭露了吉姆·琼斯是一个占有欲强且暴力的骗子。

sentences.en: The article claimed Jones was in the late stages of orchestrating a mass exodus of his temple to their commune in Guyana.
sentences.zh: 文章称，琼斯正处于策划其圣殿成员大规模迁往圭亚那公社的最后阶段。

sentences.en: Prior to the article's publication, the magazine's editor warned Jim Jones about the article's content.
sentences.zh: 在文章发表之前，杂志编辑曾就文章内容警告过吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: Jones knew backlash over the article would open him up to investigation and possibly criminal charges or civil suits.
sentences.zh: 琼斯知道，围绕这篇文章的强烈反对将使他面临调查，并可能导致刑事指控或民事诉讼。

sentences.en: His entire organisation would be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他的整个组织都将毁于一旦。

sentences.en: So Jones escaped for Guyana six hours before the article went to print.
sentences.zh: 于是，琼斯在文章付印前六小时逃往了圭亚那。

sentences.en: And as the article predicted, he ordered his temple members to follow him.
sentences.zh: 正如文章所预言的那样，他命令他的圣殿成员跟随他而去。

sentences.en: The mass exodus to Guyana happened almost overnight.
sentences.zh: 前往圭亚那的大规模出逃几乎是一夜之间发生的。

sentences.en: Temple members were told Father had called them to the Promised Land.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员被告知，父亲（Father）已召唤他们前往应许之地。

sentences.en: They packed their belongings, quit their jobs, and abandoned their families and friends.
sentences.zh: 他们收拾好行李，辞掉工作，抛弃了家人和朋友。

sentences.en: To avoid suspicion, members told loved ones they were going on a routine temple bus trip.
sentences.zh: 为了避免怀疑，成员们告诉亲人他们只是去参加一次例行的圣殿巴士旅行。

sentences.en: Temple staff forged letters on behalf of members stating they left for Jonestown voluntarily and were in good spirits.
sentences.zh: 圣殿工作人员代成员伪造了信件，声称他们是自愿前往琼斯镇的，且精神状态良好。

sentences.en: To avoid unwanted attention, buses split the hundreds of migrants between airports across the country.
sentences.zh: 为了避免引起不必要的注意，巴士将数百名移民分散到全国各地的机场。

sentences.en: The media noticed the disappearing act, but People's Temple quickly released statements denying they were pulling out of America.
sentences.zh: 媒体注意到了这种消失的行为，但人民圣殿教很快发表声明，否认他们正在撤出美国。

sentences.en: They attacked the media for orchestrating a well-coordinated conspiracy and smear campaign against Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 他们抨击媒体针对吉姆·琼斯策划了一场协调一致的阴谋和抹黑运动。

sentences.en: Over the following days, worried friends and relatives of Temple members arrived at the Temple's San Francisco headquarters.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，圣殿成员忧心忡忡的亲友们来到了圣殿的旧金山总部。

sentences.en: But no one answered the door.
sentences.zh: 但没有人应门。

sentences.en: One worried relative told the media,
sentences.zh: 一位忧心忡忡的亲属告诉媒体，

sentences.en: Temple members were excited to go to Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员对前往琼斯镇感到兴奋。

sentences.en: For years, they'd listened to updates of Jonestown over radio and watched the videos.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们一直通过广播收听琼斯镇的最新消息，并观看相关视频。

sentences.en: They thought they would be visiting for just days, weeks, or maybe even months, but would eventually return to America.
sentences.zh: 他们以为只是去访问几天、几周，甚至几个月，最终还是会回到美国。

sentences.en: But they were unaware of a confidential order direct from Jim Jones to Temple leadership.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不知道吉姆·琼斯直接下达给圣殿领导层的机密命令。

sentences.en: The trip to Guyana was final for anyone who took it.
sentences.zh: 对于任何踏上这段旅程的人来说，去圭亚那都是不归路。

sentences.en: No one would ever return to America.
sentences.zh: 没有人会再回到美国。

sentences.en: Once in Guyana, new arrivals were made to surrender their belongings, as everything was communal in Socialist Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 一旦到达圭亚那，新来者就被迫交出财物，因为在社会主义的琼斯镇，一切都是公有的。

sentences.en: Their passports were confiscated for safekeeping and locked away.
sentences.zh: 他们的护照被没收并锁起来保管。

sentences.en: Jonestown leadership determined housing and job placements.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的领导层决定住房和工作分配。

sentences.en: Parents were upset to find they were lied to.
sentences.zh: 父母们发现自己被骗了，感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: There wasn't a cottage for every family in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇并没有为每个家庭提供小屋。

sentences.en: Leadership divided couples into different cottages.
sentences.zh: 领导层将夫妻分在不同的小屋里。

sentences.en: Men and women were housed separately, and children were taken to the nursery.
sentences.zh: 男女分开居住，孩子们被带到了托儿所。

sentences.en: Long-time Jonestown residents were anxious.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的老居民感到焦虑不安。

sentences.en: The mass exodus from America brought more than 500 new people into Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 从美国的大规模出逃为琼斯镇带来了500多名新成员。

sentences.en: Within weeks, the population spiked from 400 to almost 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 几周内，人口从400人激增至近1000人。

sentences.en: Jonestown wasn't equipped to sustain a population of that size.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇并没有能力维持如此规模的人口。

sentences.en: It was already struggling with the population it had before the exodus.
sentences.zh: 在这次出逃之前，它就已经在为现有的人口而挣扎了。

sentences.en: Each residential cottage was designed for four people.
sentences.zh: 每间住宅小屋的设计容量为四人。

sentences.en: They now housed between 10 and 20 people.
sentences.zh: 现在却挤进了10到20人。

sentences.en: Some cottages were missing doors and window screens.
sentences.zh: 有些小屋甚至没有门和窗纱。

sentences.en: Cramped inside were combinations of double and triple bunk beds, with additional beds in the upper loft area.
sentences.zh: 狭窄的空间里挤满了双层和三层双层床，上层阁楼区域还加了床位。

sentences.en: Mattresses were thin slabs of foam, and blankets were too thick.
sentences.zh: 床垫是薄薄的泡沫板，毯子却厚得过分。

sentences.en: Cottages would become stifling hot as the South American sun roasted their corrugated iron roofs.
sentences.zh: 当南美洲的太阳炙烤着波纹铁皮屋顶时，小屋里会变得闷热难耐。

sentences.en: Residents were woken each day at 6am, and sometimes as early as 3am.
sentences.zh: 居民们每天早上6点被叫醒，有时甚至早至凌晨3点。

sentences.en: Newcomers were expected to head straight into the agricultural fields and start working upwards of 12 to 16 hours per day.
sentences.zh: 新来者被要求直接前往农田，每天开始长达12到16小时的工作。

sentences.en: Soon, all meals consisted of rice and gravy.
sentences.zh: 很快，所有的餐食都变成了米饭和肉汁。

sentences.en: Portion sizes shrunk daily, and some meals were skipped entirely.
sentences.zh: 份量每天都在减少，有些餐食甚至完全被取消了。

sentences.en: Food became currency.
sentences.zh: 食物成了货币。

sentences.en: You'd earn it if you worked for it.
sentences.zh: 你得干活才能换取食物。

sentences.en: Insects fell in the soupy, sticky pots of food, and they were impossible to pick out.
sentences.zh: 昆虫掉进粘稠的食物锅里，根本挑不出来。

sentences.en: So people ate in darkness to avoid seeing what ended up in their mouths.
sentences.zh: 所以人们在黑暗中进食，以免看到嘴里吃进去的是什么。

sentences.en: Gone were the days of cooked meat, pastries, coffee, and peanut butter fudge.
sentences.zh: 熟肉、糕点、咖啡和花生酱软糖的日子一去不复返了。

sentences.en: Wounds festered.
sentences.zh: 伤口开始溃烂。

sentences.en: Infections spread.
sentences.zh: 感染四处蔓延。

sentences.en: Mosquito bites dotted skin.
sentences.zh: 皮肤上布满了蚊虫叮咬的痕迹。

sentences.en: Diarrhea, dehydration, intestinal worms, and rashes were common.
sentences.zh: 腹泻、脱水、肠道寄生虫和皮疹成了家常便饭。

sentences.en: The promised land was everything but what they were promised.
sentences.zh: 这片应许之地除了他们被承诺的那样，其他什么都不是。

sentences.en: Jonestown wasn't a place of freedom and equality.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇根本不是一个自由和平等的乐土。

sentences.en: It was more like a police state.
sentences.zh: 它更像是一个警察国家。

sentences.en: As People's Temple members suffered, their leader lived comfortably in his two-bedroom Westhouse cottage with his mistresses.
sentences.zh: 当人民圣殿教的成员受苦受难时，他们的领袖却和情妇们舒适地住在他的两居室韦斯特豪斯小屋里。

sentences.en: Jones' cabin had air conditioning, a double bed, window screens, a typewriter, a radio, and a refrigerator stocked with his favourite soft drinks and treats.
sentences.zh: 琼斯的小屋里有空调、双人床、窗纱、打字机、收音机，冰箱里还塞满了各种他最爱的软饮和零食。

sentences.en: His daily meals consisted of meat, salad, jelly, and coffee.
sentences.zh: 他每天的餐食包括肉类、沙拉、果冻和咖啡。

sentences.en: Despite his luxuries, Jones felt like a prisoner in his own home.
sentences.zh: 尽管生活奢华，琼斯却觉得自己像个囚犯一样困在自己的家里。

sentences.en: His reputation in the States was ruined, and he could never return.
sentences.zh: 他在美国的名声已经毁了，再也回不去了。

sentences.en: Paranoia withheld personal responsibility.
sentences.zh: 偏执让他逃避了个人责任。

sentences.en: He was convinced his enemies, including the US government, the CIA, and Temple defectors, were out to destroy him.
sentences.zh: 他坚信他的敌人，包括美国政府、中央情报局和圣殿叛逃者，都想置他于死地。

sentences.en: To cope, he became more dependent on drugs and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 为了应对，他变得更加依赖毒品和酒精。

sentences.en: Loyal aides kept an eye on Jonestown residents, and updated Jones on the status of the commune.
sentences.zh: 忠诚的助手们监视着琼斯镇的居民，并向琼斯汇报公社的状况。

sentences.en: Reports were always the same.
sentences.zh: 报告的内容总是千篇一律。

sentences.en: People weren't happy.
sentences.zh: 人们并不快乐。

sentences.en: They missed America.
sentences.zh: 他们想念美国。

sentences.en: Jonestown residents were sent hundreds of letters from worried loved ones back home.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的居民收到了数百封来自国内忧心忡忡的亲友寄来的信件。

sentences.en: Her father sought answers from his ex-wife who took their children to Guyana.
sentences.zh: 一位父亲向带走孩子去圭亚那的前妻寻求答案。

sentences.en: Her brother asked his sister to see him before he died of cancer.
sentences.zh: 一位哥哥请求妹妹在他死于癌症前见他一面。

sentences.en: One letter notified a mother that her daughter had overdosed.
sentences.zh: 一封信通知一位母亲，她的女儿已经服药过量。

sentences.en: Some put money inside their letters for flights back home.
sentences.zh: 有些人还在信里塞了钱，希望他们能买机票回家。

sentences.en: Letters were first received by Jonestown senior staff, and then read to Jones.
sentences.zh: 信件先由琼斯镇的高层工作人员接收，然后读给琼斯听。

sentences.en: When asked if the recipients should receive their mail, Jones' reply was always the same.
sentences.zh: 当被问及收件人是否应该收到信件时，琼斯的回答总是如出一辙。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Residents started to question why they weren't receiving letters anymore.
sentences.zh: 居民们开始质疑为什么他们再也收不到信了。

sentences.en: At first, Jones blamed the US government.
sentences.zh: 起初，琼斯把责任推给美国政府。

sentences.en: And when that answer became unsatisfactory, he claimed their relatives had simply stopped writing for them.
sentences.zh: 当这个答案无法令人满意时，他便声称他们的亲戚已经不再给他们写信了。

sentences.en: Jones allowed for outgoing mail under the condition that letters were written in front of censors.
sentences.zh: 琼斯允许寄出信件，条件是必须在审查员面前书写。

sentences.en: Approved letters were filled with lies about what residents were eating, what they were achieving, and how healthy and how happy they were.
sentences.zh: 获准寄出的信件里充满了谎言，谎称居民们吃得很好，取得了什么成就，生活得多么健康快乐。

sentences.en: Jones rigged a loudspeaker system throughout Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在整个琼斯镇安装了扩音器系统。

sentences.en: Every day, for hours at a time, he'd rant into a microphone about America, fascists, and his enemies.
sentences.zh: 每天，他都会对着麦克风滔滔不绝地谩骂美国、法西斯分子和他的敌人，一讲就是几个小时。

sentences.en: And he would give his own biased opinions and commentaries on reported news.
sentences.zh: 他还会对报道的新闻发表自己带有偏见的观点和评论。

sentences.en: Jonestown resident Deborah Layton, quote,
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇居民黛博拉·莱顿曾引用道：

sentences.en: Jones used the droning broadcasts as a deliberate psychological technique to interrupt free thinking.
sentences.zh: 琼斯利用这些单调的广播作为一种蓄意的心理手段，来阻断人们的自由思考。

sentences.en: It kept listeners in a disjointed state that made them receptive to fed information.
sentences.zh: 这让听众处于一种思维断层的状态，从而更容易接受被灌输的信息。

sentences.en: Access to radio and television had been prohibited, so members had no idea what was truly happening outside of Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 由于禁止接触广播和电视，成员们根本不知道琼斯镇外到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Large-scale race riots, mass murder of minorities, and the reintroduction of slavery were just some of the lies Jones spread about America.
sentences.zh: 大规模种族骚乱、针对少数族裔的大屠杀以及奴隶制的恢复，只是琼斯散布的关于美国的谎言中的一部分。

sentences.en: He wanted to make life in Jonestown appear better than life back home.
sentences.zh: 他想让琼斯镇的生活看起来比国内的生活更好。

sentences.en: Residents were quizzed daily on the content of Jones' broadcasts.
sentences.zh: 居民们每天都要接受关于琼斯广播内容的测验。

sentences.en: Those who failed the tests were made to work twice as hard, and were forbidden to talk to others.
sentences.zh: 那些不及格的人会被加倍惩罚，被迫干活，且被禁止与他人交谈。

sentences.en: Jones' loudspeaker ramblings were frantic, nonsensical, and outrageous.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在扩音器里的胡言乱语疯狂、荒谬且令人发指。

sentences.en: Some residents quietly contemplated if Jim Jones had finally gone insane.
sentences.zh: 一些居民私下里开始怀疑吉姆·琼斯是否终于疯了。

sentences.en: In December 1977, four months after moving to Jonestown, Jim Jones' mother, Lynetta, passed away.
sentences.zh: 1977年12月，在搬到琼斯镇四个月后，吉姆·琼斯的母亲莱内塔去世了。

sentences.en: Lynetta lived in her own private cottage.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔住在一间私人小屋里。

sentences.en: A long-time smoker, she suffered from lung disease and rarely left her bed.
sentences.zh: 她是个老烟民，患有肺病，几乎足不出户。

sentences.en: One day she had a stroke, and two days later she was dead.
sentences.zh: 有一天她中风了，两天后就去世了。

sentences.en: Publicly, Lynetta was a great defender of her son.
sentences.zh: 在公开场合，莱内塔一直是他儿子的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: Jones loved his mother deeply.
sentences.zh: 琼斯深爱着他的母亲。

sentences.en: Her avid interest in humanitarianism defined his formative years and influenced his goals in life.
sentences.zh: 她对人道主义的热切关注定义了他成长的岁月，并影响了他的人生目标。

sentences.en: Privately, Lynetta was the only person of Jones' inner circle unafraid to confront, shame, and control him.
sentences.zh: 私下里，莱内塔是琼斯核心圈子里唯一不怕与他对抗、让他蒙羞并控制他的人。

sentences.en: When Lynetta died, it caused the dramatic shift to ripple throughout Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔的去世在整个琼斯镇引发了巨大的震荡。

sentences.en: Jones lost his only source of authoritative moderation and constraint.
sentences.zh: 琼斯失去了他唯一的权威调节和约束来源。

sentences.en: Now, no one could stop him.
sentences.zh: 现在，再也没有人能阻止他了。

sentences.en: Jones called a meeting at the pavilion days after his mother's passing.
sentences.zh: 母亲去世几天后，琼斯在凉亭召开了一次会议。

sentences.en: The topic of conversation was death, and Jones considered and compared the different ways to die,
sentences.zh: 谈话的主题是死亡，琼斯思考并比较了各种死亡方式，

sentences.en: remarking that drowning would be most preferable, as it is easy, numbing, and peaceful.
sentences.zh: 他评论说溺水是最可取的，因为它简单、麻木且平静。

sentences.en: His crowd remained silent.
sentences.zh: 人群保持沉默。

sentences.en: Jones yelled at them,
sentences.zh: 琼斯对他们大吼道：

sentences.en: Some of you people get so fucking nervous every time I talk about death.
sentences.zh: 你们这些人每次我谈到死亡时都紧张得要死。

sentences.en: When an elderly woman scowled at him, Jones told her,
sentences.zh: 当一位老妇人对他怒目而视时，琼斯对她说：

sentences.en: You're gonna die someday, honey.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，你总有一天会死的。

sentences.en: You old bitch.
sentences.zh: 你这个老婊子。

sentences.en: You're gonna die.
sentences.zh: 你会死的。

sentences.en: One night from the depths of the jungle, a gunman fired several bullets in quick succession at Westhouse.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，从丛林深处，一名枪手向韦斯特豪斯连开了几枪。

sentences.en: The bullets narrowly missed Jim Jones, who was standing at the window at the time.
sentences.zh: 子弹险些击中当时正站在窗边的吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: He ran to the loudspeaker and yelled to his people,
sentences.zh: 他跑到扩音器前，对着人们大喊：

sentences.en: Alert!
sentences.zh: 警报！

sentences.en: Alert!
sentences.zh: 警报！

sentences.en: We are under attack!
sentences.zh: 我们遭到袭击了！

sentences.en: Frightened residents ran to the pavilion, and Jones was waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 惊恐的居民跑向凉亭，琼斯正在那里等着他们。

sentences.en: Their government allies had abandoned them, he said, and now fascist mercenaries had surrounded Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们的政府盟友抛弃了他们，现在法西斯雇佣兵已经包围了琼斯镇。

sentences.en: They were going to kidnap their children, invade the town, and capture them all.
sentences.zh: 他们要绑架他们的孩子，入侵城镇，并将他们全部俘虏。

sentences.en: This pervasive feeling of being under attack felt very real to Jonestown residents.
sentences.zh: 这种遭到袭击的普遍感觉对琼斯镇的居民来说非常真实。

sentences.en: Jones' daily loudspeaker tirades often featured warnings that enemy forces were heading to Guyana to destroy them.
sentences.zh: 琼斯每天的扩音器咆哮中，经常充斥着敌军正前往圭亚那消灭他们的警告。

sentences.en: Farming tools were handed out to residents, who were ordered to stand in a line facing the jungle.
sentences.zh: 农具被分发给居民，他们被命令排成一列面对丛林站立。

sentences.en: They were told to defend Jonestown from the invading mercenaries, or die trying.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知要保卫琼斯镇免受入侵雇佣兵的侵害，否则就死在这里。

sentences.en: No one in the line knew that the gunman who shot at Jim Jones was not an enemy mercenary.
sentences.zh: 队列中没有人知道，那个向吉姆·琼斯开枪的枪手并不是什么敌方雇佣兵。

sentences.en: It was their leader's son, Jim Jones Jr.
sentences.zh: 那是他们领袖的儿子，吉姆·琼斯二世。

sentences.en: He'd been ordered by his father to go into the jungle and shoot at Westhouse.
sentences.zh: 他奉父亲之命进入丛林，向韦斯特豪斯开枪。

sentences.en: Jones pressed himself against the interior side wall to avoid the bullets he knew were coming.
sentences.zh: 琼斯紧贴着内侧墙壁，以躲避他明知会射来的子弹。

sentences.en: Anxious residents watched the jungle throughout the night and into the morning.
sentences.zh: 焦虑的居民们整夜守望着丛林，直到天亮。

sentences.en: They were permitted to sleep in short shifts before taking their defensive positions once more.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许轮流小睡片刻，然后再次回到防御阵地。

sentences.en: Jones allowed them to work during the day to maintain food production, but at night, he ordered them back into defensive lines.
sentences.zh: 琼斯允许他们白天工作以维持粮食生产，但到了晚上，他命令他们回到防御阵线。

sentences.en: Traumatised children were sedated while Jones walked the line in tears, saying goodbye to each person.
sentences.zh: 受惊的孩子们被注射了镇静剂，而琼斯则含泪走过队列，与每个人告别。

sentences.en: This was it, he told them.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，这就是终局了。

sentences.en: This siege lasted six days.
sentences.zh: 这场围困持续了六天。

sentences.en: On the sixth day, Jones permitted his makeshift army to stand down.
sentences.zh: 第六天，琼斯允许他的临时军队撤防。

sentences.en: He gave a rousing speech about how they all proved they'd rather die than surrender to their enemies.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一场激动人心的演讲，称他们都证明了自己宁愿死也不愿向敌人投降。

sentences.en: Jones asked who was willing to die and commit revolutionary suicide for their cause.
sentences.zh: 琼斯问谁愿意为了他们的事业去死，去进行革命性的自杀。

sentences.en: Only two people out of hundreds raised their hands.
sentences.zh: 数百人中只有两个人举起了手。

sentences.en: They were two members of Jones' inner circle.
sentences.zh: 他们是琼斯核心圈子的两名成员。

sentences.en: Everyone else wanted to fight.
sentences.zh: 其他人只想战斗。

sentences.en: They felt they owed their commitment to socialism to stay alive as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得他们对社会主义的承诺要求他们尽可能活下去。

sentences.en: They didn't come to Jonestown to die.
sentences.zh: 他们来琼斯镇不是为了送死。

sentences.en: Jones called a meeting in the pavilion every night.
sentences.zh: 琼斯每晚都在凉亭召开会议。

sentences.en: He'd press a microphone to his lips, only stopping his long-winded rants to chew on blocks of ice, peanuts or pills.
sentences.zh: 他会把麦克风贴在嘴边，只有在咀嚼冰块、花生或药片时才会停下他那冗长的咆哮。

sentences.en: Jones looked puffier and puffier at each meeting.
sentences.zh: 每次会议上，琼斯看起来都越来越浮肿。

sentences.en: He still wore his trademark sunglasses at all times to hide his red drug-hazed gaze.
sentences.zh: 他始终戴着标志性的太阳镜，以掩盖他那双因药物而充血的眼睛。

sentences.en: Sickly, aggressive and easily distracted, Jones constantly licked his lips, a habit common in drug abusers.
sentences.zh: 琼斯病恹恹的、极具攻击性且容易分心，他不停地舔着嘴唇，这是药物滥用者常见的习惯。

sentences.en: His speech stuttered and slurred, and he interchangeably blamed exhaustion, illness, a tooth infection, incorrect medication, and the sound system for his odd behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他说话结结巴巴，含糊不清，并交替将自己怪异的行为归咎于疲劳、疾病、牙齿感染、药物错误和音响系统。

sentences.en: Residents cheered, sang, and rallied at his order.
sentences.zh: 居民们在他的命令下欢呼、歌唱并集会。

sentences.en: But their enthusiasm was weak.
sentences.zh: 但他们的热情很低落。

sentences.en: Jones would rant for hours without break, even when his audience appeared bored and weren't paying attention.
sentences.zh: 琼斯会滔滔不绝地讲上几个小时，即使听众看起来很无聊，根本没在听。

sentences.en: During meetings, Jones would often get drunk and vulgar.
sentences.zh: 在会议期间，琼斯经常喝得酩酊大醉，言语粗俗。

sentences.en: He'd swear and threaten people, brag about sex, burp, urinate, and vomit.
sentences.zh: 他会咒骂、威胁他人，吹嘘性事，打嗝、随地小便和呕吐。

sentences.en: During one meeting, he shot a pistol into the air and yelled, I ought to kill every last one of you.
sentences.zh: 在一次会议上，他向空中开了一枪，大喊道：“我真该把你们这些家伙全杀了。”

sentences.en: Meetings went all night, with residents crawling into bed at 4am, only to be woken an hour or two later to start work.
sentences.zh: 会议持续整晚，居民们凌晨4点才爬上床，没过一两个小时又被叫醒去干活。

sentences.en: Jones continued to dole out punishments at these meetings.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在这些会议上继续分发惩罚。

sentences.en: Gone were the whipping belt and the board of education.
sentences.zh: 鞭打带和教育板已经不见了。

sentences.en: They were replaced by crueler punishments that wouldn't just cause physical pain, but extreme mental distress.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是更残酷的惩罚，不仅会造成身体痛苦，还会带来极度的精神折磨。

sentences.en: One teenage boy was forced to eat slices of an incredibly spicy native pepper after it was discovered he was growing his own watermelon crop.
sentences.zh: 一名十几岁的男孩被发现私自种植西瓜，被迫吃下几片极其辛辣的本地辣椒。

sentences.en: A 60-year-old woman was punished by being stripped naked and paraded down the aisles of the pavilion.
sentences.zh: 一名60岁的妇女受到的惩罚是被剥光衣服，在展馆的过道里游街示众。

sentences.en: Troublemakers were tied to a pole and left on the edge of the jungle under the impression they were going to be eaten by a tiger.
sentences.zh: 捣乱分子被绑在柱子上，扔在丛林边缘，让他们以为自己会被老虎吃掉。

sentences.en: A resident deathly afraid of snakes was forced to endure a snake being wrapped around her.
sentences.zh: 一名极其怕蛇的居民被迫忍受一条蛇缠绕在身上。

sentences.en: Another was marched into the jungle and had a gun pressed against his head until he agreed to apologise to Jim Jones for his wrongdoings.
sentences.zh: 另一名居民被押进丛林，枪口顶着头，直到他同意为自己的不当行为向吉姆·琼斯道歉。

sentences.en: Other transgressors were berated by the crowd, slapped and beaten.
sentences.zh: 其他违规者则受到人群的斥责、掌掴和殴打。

sentences.en: This misplaced violence between residents was a form of emotional release.
sentences.zh: 这种居民之间错位的暴力是一种情感宣泄。

sentences.en: Some residents were locked in the box for several days.
sentences.zh: 一些居民被关在“箱子”里好几天。

sentences.en: The box was a 1.2 by 1.8 metre shipping container that had been dug into the earth.
sentences.zh: “箱子”是一个埋在土里的1.2米乘1.8米的集装箱。

sentences.en: It was soundproof, dark and hot.
sentences.zh: 里面隔音、黑暗且闷热。

sentences.en: The sensory and social deprivation caused them to hallucinate.
sentences.zh: 感官和社交的剥夺导致他们产生了幻觉。

sentences.en: For long-term punishment, Jones invented the learning crew.
sentences.zh: 对于长期惩罚，琼斯发明了“学习小组”。

sentences.en: Infractions that could get you assigned to the learning crew included being late to work, worshipping God, acting capitalist, or saying the words,
sentences.zh: 会导致你被分配到“学习小组”的违规行为包括工作迟到、崇拜上帝、表现出资本主义倾向，或者说出这样的话：

sentences.en: I want to go home.
sentences.zh: “我想回家。”

sentences.en: The learning crew were forced to do low-status, exhausting, and undesirable tasks.
sentences.zh: “学习小组”成员被迫从事地位低下、精疲力竭且令人厌恶的工作。

sentences.en: Repeat offenders got extended sentences.
sentences.zh: 累犯会受到更长的刑期。

sentences.en: The special care unit was an area in the medical section of Jonestown reserved for the most rebellious residents.
sentences.zh: “特别护理单元”是琼斯镇医疗区内专门为最叛逆的居民保留的区域。

sentences.en: Those who were increasingly vocal in expressing opposition to Jones.
sentences.zh: 那些越来越大声表达对琼斯不满的人。

sentences.en: Protesters were restrained and sedated with drugs until they were almost catatonic.
sentences.zh: 抗议者被束缚住并注射镇静剂，直到他们几乎处于木僵状态。

sentences.en: If they wouldn't willingly swallow the tranquilizers, they were forcibly injected.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不愿主动吞下镇静剂，就会被强行注射。

sentences.en: It seemed impossible to escape Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 逃离琼斯镇似乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: The surrounding thick walls of unexplored jungle were impossible to track for most residents.
sentences.zh: 周围厚厚的原始丛林墙壁对大多数居民来说根本无法穿越。

sentences.en: However, one person took a chance.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一个人冒险尝试了。

sentences.en: On an early August morning, Guyanese police in Port Kytuma noticed a dishevelled man emerge from the dense jungle.
sentences.zh: 八月初的一个早晨，圭亚那凯图马港的警察注意到一个衣衫褴褛的男人从茂密的丛林中走出来。

sentences.en: He introduced himself as Leon Brassard, a member of People's Temple and resident of Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 他自称是里昂·布拉萨德，是人民圣殿教的成员，也是琼斯镇的居民。

sentences.en: Leon told the police Jonestown was a slave colony.
sentences.zh: 里昂告诉警察，琼斯镇是一个奴隶殖民地。

sentences.en: When Guyanese police investigated,
sentences.zh: 当圭亚那警方进行调查时，

sentences.en: Jim Jones called Leon a drug-addicted liar, but agreed to return the man's passport and pay for him to return to the US.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯称里昂是一个吸毒成瘾的骗子，但同意归还该男子的护照并支付他回美国的费用。

sentences.en: After this escape,
sentences.zh: 这次逃跑事件后，

sentences.en: Jones encouraged his followers to spy on each other and report dissent.
sentences.zh: 琼斯鼓励他的追随者互相监视并举报异见。

sentences.en: If a resident looked too long at the jungle, they were reported for plotting an escape.
sentences.zh: 如果一名居民盯着丛林看太久，就会被举报企图逃跑。

sentences.en: Residents became so paranoid about their thoughts and behaviour, they confessed to minor infractions before others could dob them in.
sentences.zh: 居民们对自己的思想和行为变得如此多疑，以至于在别人举报他们之前，他们就主动承认了轻微的违规行为。

sentences.en: Jonestown resident Vernon Gosney recalled,
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇居民弗农·戈斯尼回忆道：

sentences.en: A father would turn in a son.
sentences.zh: “父亲会举报儿子。”

sentences.en: A husband would turn in a wife.
sentences.zh: “丈夫会举报妻子。”

sentences.en: A small child would turn in a parent.
sentences.zh: “小孩会举报父母。”

sentences.en: There was no freedom to express to one another what was going on, because everything was suspect.
sentences.zh: 没有自由去向彼此表达发生了什么，因为一切都令人怀疑。

sentences.en: The most forbidden thing to express was to leave.
sentences.zh: 最被禁止表达的事情就是离开。

sentences.en: Jonestown's resident doctor was a 29-year-old man called Lawrence Eugene Sharkt.
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的常驻医生是一名29岁的男子，名叫劳伦斯·尤金·沙克特。

sentences.en: Lawrence, or Larry as he was known, was once addicted to crystal meth, and People's Temple helped rehabilitate him.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯，也就是大家熟知的拉里，曾经沉迷于冰毒，是人民圣殿教帮助他康复的。

sentences.en: Temple leadership noted Sharkt as emotionally unstable and insecure, but also highly intelligent.
sentences.zh: 圣殿领导层认为沙克特情绪不稳定且缺乏安全感，但同时也非常聪明。

sentences.en: The Temple funded Sharkt to study medicine at university.
sentences.zh: 圣殿资助沙克特在大学学习医学。

sentences.en: He graduated with honours and began an internship at San Francisco General Hospital.
sentences.zh: 他以优异成绩毕业，并开始在旧金山总医院实习。

sentences.en: But by the fifth week of his internship, Sharkt disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但在实习的第五周，沙克特失踪了。

sentences.en: Jim Jones had ordered him to Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯命令他前往琼斯镇。

sentences.en: Sharkt was the only doctor in Jonestown, and his inexperience was a problem.
sentences.zh: 沙克特是琼斯镇唯一的医生，他的经验不足是个问题。

sentences.en: He was unfamiliar with treating simple medical issues, such as setting broken bones and medicating skin rashes.
sentences.zh: 他不熟悉处理简单的医疗问题，比如接骨和治疗皮疹。

sentences.en: Dr. Sharkt worked up to 16 hours per day looking after all 1,000 Jonestown residents.
sentences.zh: 沙克特医生每天工作长达16小时，照顾琼斯镇全部1000名居民。

sentences.en: To cope, he started taking the calming drug Valium, but it fostered depressive tendencies within him.
sentences.zh: 为了应对压力，他开始服用镇静药物安定，但这加剧了他的抑郁倾向。

sentences.en: To Jonestown residents, Dr. Sharkt was a strange loner who was emotionally unstable, paranoid, and highly inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 对琼斯镇居民来说，沙克特医生是一个奇怪的独行侠，情绪不稳定、多疑且非常不合群。

sentences.en: He would perform prostate exams on male Temple members who didn't require them.
sentences.zh: 他会给不需要检查的男性圣殿成员进行前列腺检查。

sentences.en: Jonestown resident Laura Johnston Cole recalled,
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇居民劳拉·约翰斯顿·科尔回忆道：

sentences.en: Larry was really different because once he got to Jonestown, he never really established close relationships with anyone.
sentences.zh: “拉里真的很特别，因为一旦到了琼斯镇，他就从未真正与任何人建立过亲密关系。”

sentences.en: It's almost like he was kind of a recluse in the community.
sentences.zh: “他就像社区里的隐士一样。”

sentences.en: There wasn't anybody else in Larry's life that was anywhere near as monumental as his relationship with Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: “拉里的生活中没有其他人像他与吉姆·琼斯的关系那样重要。”

sentences.en: There's not one friend that I can think of that Larry ever spent time with or hung around.
sentences.zh: “我想不出拉里曾经和哪个朋友在一起待过或混在一起。”

sentences.en: Dr. Sharkt had one free day per week.
sentences.zh: 沙克特医生每周有一天休息时间。

sentences.en: Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 星期三。

sentences.en: But it wasn't long before Jones gave him work to do on Wednesdays as well.
sentences.zh: 但没过多久，琼斯也让他周三工作。

sentences.en: Private, discreet work.
sentences.zh: 私下的、隐秘的工作。

sentences.en: Jones had ordered him to find ways to carry out a mass suicide.
sentences.zh: 琼斯命令他寻找执行集体自杀的方法。

sentences.en: Jones had been obsessed with the idea of killing his entire congregation for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，琼斯一直沉迷于杀死他整个会众的想法。

sentences.en: Prior to relocating to Guyana,
sentences.zh: 在搬迁到圭亚那之前，

sentences.en: Jones had orchestrated mock mass suicides within his own leadership group.
sentences.zh: 琼斯就在他自己的领导小组内策划过模拟集体自杀。

sentences.en: Those who had witnessed Jones' death plans had brushed them away as loyalty tests.
sentences.zh: 那些目睹过琼斯死亡计划的人都将其视为忠诚度测试而置之不理。

sentences.en: When Dr. Sharkt was given the direct order to find an ideal way to kill 1,000 people, over 300 of whom were children,
sentences.zh: 当沙克特医生接到直接命令，要找到杀死1000人的理想方法（其中300多人是儿童）时，

sentences.en: his first step was to ask Jones for a book on forensic medicine.
sentences.zh: 他的第一步是向琼斯索要一本法医学书籍。

sentences.en: Dr. Larry Sharkt, quote,
sentences.zh: 拉里·沙克特医生，引用如下：

sentences.en: In May 1978, Dr. Sharkt believed he'd come up with the quickest and cleanest method for mass suicide.
sentences.zh: 1978年5月，沙克特医生认为他已经找到了最快、最干净的集体自杀方法。

sentences.en: Cyanide.
sentences.zh: 氰化物。

sentences.en: Sharkt explained to Jones that cyanide was one of the most rapidly acting poisons.
sentences.zh: 沙克特向琼斯解释说，氰化物是作用最快的毒药之一。

sentences.en: Depending on the dosage, cyanide could take up to three hours or only minutes to kill.
sentences.zh: 根据剂量不同，氰化物可能需要长达三小时，也可能只需几分钟就能致死。

sentences.en: Cyanide poisoning stops body cells from absorbing oxygen and results in the sensation of suffocation.
sentences.zh: 氰化物中毒会阻止身体细胞吸收氧气，导致窒息感。

sentences.en: Symptoms of cyanide poisoning occur within minutes and include headaches, dizziness, fast heart rate, shortness of breath and vomiting,
sentences.zh: 氰化物中毒的症状在几分钟内就会出现，包括头痛、头晕、心跳加快、呼吸急促和呕吐，

sentences.en: followed by seizures, slow heart rate, low blood pressure and loss of consciousness, ending in cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 随后是癫痫发作、心率减慢、低血压和意识丧失，最终导致心脏骤停。

sentences.en: Jonestown residents noticed Dr. Sharkt exhibiting strange behaviour around town,
sentences.zh: 琼斯镇的居民注意到沙克特医生在镇上表现出奇怪的行为，

sentences.en: muttering to nobody, shaking, appearing sick and ingesting large amounts of the calming drug Thorazine.
sentences.zh: 对着空气喃喃自语、颤抖、看起来生病，并服用大量的镇静药物氯丙嗪。

sentences.en: No one knew why the doctor was increasingly on edge or what he was planning to do to them all.
sentences.zh: 没人知道为什么这位医生越来越紧张，也不知道他打算对他们所有人做什么。

sentences.en: Jim Jones started importing guns into Jonestown, hidden in false crates marked Agricultural Suppliers.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯开始向琼斯镇进口枪支，藏在标有“农业供应商”的假板条箱里。

sentences.en: He referred to them as Bibles.
sentences.zh: 他称这些枪支为“圣经”。

sentences.en: He amassed over 30 different firearms and said, there are enough Bibles here to do a lot of praying if necessary.
sentences.zh: 他囤积了30多支不同的枪支，并说：“这里有足够的‘圣经’，必要时可以做很多祈祷。”

sentences.en: Jones called a town meeting at the pavilion.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在展馆召开了城镇会议。

sentences.en: When residents arrived, they were shocked to find guards circling them holding guns.
sentences.zh: 当居民们到达时，他们震惊地发现守卫正持枪围着他们。

sentences.en: Vernon Gosney recalled, quote,
sentences.zh: 弗农·戈斯尼回忆道，引用如下：

sentences.en: Jones then went on one of his usual paranoid tangents.
sentences.zh: 琼斯随后又开始了他惯常的偏执狂言。

sentences.en: One resident recalled,
sentences.zh: 一位居民回忆道：

sentences.en: He would tell us that in the United States, African Americans were being herded into concentration camps, that there was genocide on the streets.
sentences.zh: “他告诉我们，在美国，非裔美国人正被赶进集中营，街头正在发生种族灭绝。”

sentences.en: They were coming to kill and torture us because we'd chosen what he called the socialist track.
sentences.zh: “他们正要来杀害和折磨我们，因为我们选择了所谓的社会主义道路。”

sentences.en: He said they were on their way.
sentences.zh: “他说他们已经在路上了。”

sentences.en: Another resident recalled,
sentences.zh: 另一位居民回忆道：

sentences.en: We were informed that our situation had become hopeless and that the only course of action open to us was a mass suicide for the glory of socialism.
sentences.zh: “我们被告知我们的处境已经绝望，我们唯一能采取的行动就是为了社会主义的荣耀进行集体自杀。”

sentences.en: We were told that we would be tortured by mercenaries were we taken alive.
sentences.zh: “我们被告知，如果我们活着被抓，就会受到雇佣兵的折磨。”

sentences.en: Residents watched as staff brought forward stacks of paper cups, placing them on the table at the front next to a large vat filled with dark liquid.
sentences.zh: 居民们看着工作人员拿出一叠叠纸杯，放在前面的桌子上，旁边是一个装满深色液体的大桶。

sentences.en: Line up, Jones ordered.
sentences.zh: “排好队，”琼斯命令道。

sentences.en: Drink the liquid.
sentences.zh: “喝下液体。”

sentences.en: It would be painless.
sentences.zh: “这不会痛苦。”

sentences.en: In 45 minutes, you'd fall asleep forever.
sentences.zh: “45分钟内，你们就会永远睡去。”

sentences.en: When the reality of what Jones was asking of them set in, the crowd protested.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯的要求成为现实时，人群抗议起来。

sentences.en: But armed guards stood them up and marched them to the vat.
sentences.zh: 但武装警卫让他们站起来，把他们押向大桶。

sentences.en: The victim was handed a cup filled with liquid and made to drink it at gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 受害者被递上一杯装满液体的杯子，并被强迫在枪口下喝下去。

sentences.en: They were then forced to the field next to the pavilion and told to lie down.
sentences.zh: 然后他们被强行带到展馆旁边的空地上，被要求躺下。

sentences.en: Jones threatened if anyone tried to flee, they would be shot.
sentences.zh: 琼斯威胁说，如果有人试图逃跑，就会被枪杀。

sentences.en: Everyone was made to get in line to drink the liquid, even children.
sentences.zh: 每个人都被要求排队喝下液体，连孩子也不例外。

sentences.en: Those who had been through similar drills before believed this was just another one of Jones' loyalty tests.
sentences.zh: 那些经历过类似演习的人认为这只是琼斯的又一次忠诚度测试。

sentences.en: Those who continued to resist weren't shot.
sentences.zh: 那些继续反抗的人并没有被枪杀。

sentences.en: Instead, guards held them down, pulled open their jaw and poured the liquid forcibly down their throats.
sentences.zh: 相反，守卫按住他们，掰开他们的下巴，强行将液体灌入他们的喉咙。

sentences.en: Others drank willingly.
sentences.zh: 其他人则自愿喝下。

sentences.en: They were so disenfranchised by Jonestown that death was welcomed.
sentences.zh: 他们对琼斯镇感到如此绝望，以至于死亡反而是一种解脱。

sentences.en: Hundreds of stained cups were piled up around the near-empty vat, and hundreds of people lay together watching the sunset.
sentences.zh: 数百个沾满液体的杯子堆在几乎空了的大桶周围，数百人躺在一起看着日落。

sentences.en: They held each other's hands, whispered farewells, and closed their eyes to fall asleep forever.
sentences.zh: 他们握着彼此的手，低声告别，闭上眼睛，永远地睡去了。

sentences.en: Until Jones' booming voice shattered the silence.
sentences.zh: 直到琼斯洪亮的声音打破了寂静。

sentences.en: You didn't take anything.
sentences.zh: “你们什么都没喝。”

sentences.en: You had only punch, with something a little stronger in it.
sentences.zh: “你们喝的只是潘趣酒，里面加了点烈性东西。”

sentences.en: These simulated suicides would come to be part of what was called White Knights, code for extreme emergency.
sentences.zh: 这些模拟自杀后来成为所谓的“白骑士”的一部分，这是紧急情况的代号。

sentences.en: Every few weeks, Jones' voice would ring out over the loudspeaker.
sentences.zh: 每隔几周，琼斯的声音就会在扩音器里响起。

sentences.en: White Knight!
sentences.zh: “白骑士！”

sentences.en: White Knight!
sentences.zh: “白骑士！”

sentences.en: All residents would run to the pavilion, and would be made to either partake in sieges that went for days, or rallies that went for hours.
sentences.zh: 所有居民都会跑向展馆，被迫参加持续数天的围攻或持续数小时的集会。

sentences.en: Each White Knight ended the same.
sentences.zh: 每次“白骑士”的结局都一样。

sentences.en: Residents were told to line up, take a cup, drink, and die.
sentences.zh: 居民们被告知排好队，拿一个杯子，喝下去，然后死去。

sentences.en: At the end of each White Knight, Jones would laugh and clap.
sentences.zh: 在每次“白骑士”结束时，琼斯都会大笑并鼓掌。

sentences.en: But, he'd explain it was only a rehearsal, and now he knew whom he could truSt.
sentences.zh: 但他会解释说这只是排练，现在他知道谁可以信任了。

sentences.en: Then he'd say,
sentences.zh: 然后他会说：

sentences.en: Go home, my darlings.
sentences.zh: “回家吧，我的宝贝们。”

sentences.en: Sleep tight.
sentences.zh: “睡个好觉。”

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Jones was manipulating his followers into a learnt behaviour.
sentences.zh: 琼斯正在将他的追随者操纵成一种习得性行为。

sentences.en: By repeating an action over and over, until it no longer had an emotional impact.
sentences.zh: 通过一遍又一遍地重复一个动作，直到它不再产生情感冲击。

sentences.en: Frequent White Knights made each one less terrifying than the laSt.
sentences.zh: 频繁的“白骑士”让每一次都比上一次不那么可怕。

sentences.en: Eventually, as residents were handed their cup of dark-coloured liquid, nobody fought back.
sentences.zh: 最终，当居民们被递上那杯深色的液体时，没有人反抗。

sentences.en: Nobody refused.
sentences.zh: 没有人拒绝。

sentences.en: There was no fear.
sentences.zh: 没有恐惧。

sentences.en: After each White Knight, Jones would cast another vote for revolutionary suicide.
sentences.zh: 每次“白骑士”之后，琼斯都会再次进行革命性自杀的投票。

sentences.en: In the beginning, only several hands would rise.
sentences.zh: 起初，只有几只手举起来。

sentences.en: But Jones continued to call White Knights until residents were physically, mentally, and emotionally exhausted by the process.
sentences.zh: 但琼斯继续呼吁“白骑士”，直到居民们在身体、精神和情感上都对这个过程感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: White Knights became so meaningless, they just wanted them to end.
sentences.zh: “白骑士”变得毫无意义，他们只想让这一切结束。

sentences.en: And eventually, when Jones asked who would commit revolutionary suicide,
sentences.zh: 最终，当琼斯问谁愿意进行革命性自杀时，

sentences.en: all hands went up in the air.
sentences.zh: 所有人都举起了手。

sentences.en: Some American government officials visited Jonestown briefly throughout its inception.
sentences.zh: 一些美国政府官员在琼斯镇建立初期曾短暂访问过那里。

sentences.en: But Jonestown leadership would spend weeks preparing residents' answers to questions and ship in large quantities of food.
sentences.zh: 但琼斯镇的领导层会花上几周时间准备居民对问题的回答，并运入大量食物。

sentences.en: Beds were removed from cottages to dispel rumours of overcrowding.
sentences.zh: 小屋里的床位被撤走，以消除关于过度拥挤的传言。

sentences.en: Residents who looked unhealthily thin were given larger servings of food to fatten up.
sentences.zh: 看起来瘦弱不健康的居民会被分发更多的食物以增重。

sentences.en: When official visitors arrived in Jonestown, there didn't appear to be any signs of trouble.
sentences.zh: 当官方访客到达琼斯镇时，看起来没有任何麻烦的迹象。

sentences.en: When they questioned residents to see if anyone was being held against their will, residents assured them that they were free to leave if they desired.
sentences.zh: 当他们询问居民是否有人违背意愿被扣留时，居民向他们保证，如果他们愿意，随时可以离开。

sentences.en: Without seeing any guards, guns, or barbed wire, the officials left with the impression that everything was well in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 由于没有看到任何警卫、枪支或铁丝网，官员们离开时留下了琼斯镇一切安好的印象。

sentences.en: Back in America, the relatives of Temple members refused to believe the positive news coming out of Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 回到美国，圣殿成员的亲属拒绝相信从琼斯镇传出的正面消息。

sentences.en: They compared letters they had received from loved ones in Guyana.
sentences.zh: 他们对比了从圭亚那的亲人那里收到的信件。

sentences.en: Letters bore striking similarities to each other, quoting similar lines of text.
sentences.zh: 信件之间有着惊人的相似之处，引用了相似的文本行。

sentences.en: They noticed things such as spelling errors being crossed out and corrected in someone else's handwriting.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到了一些细节，比如拼写错误被划掉，并用他人的笔迹进行了更正。

sentences.en: Letters arrived unsealed.
sentences.zh: 信件寄到时都是未密封的。

sentences.en: Some were cut off at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 有些信件底部被剪掉了。

sentences.en: Eventually, they stopped receiving letters at all.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们彻底收不到信了。

sentences.en: Together with ex-Temple members, they founded a support group called the Concerned Relatives.
sentences.zh: 他们与前圣殿成员一起，成立了一个名为“关切亲属”的支持团体。

sentences.en: The concerned relatives picketed in San Francisco and sent letters to the media, government officials, and members of Congress.
sentences.zh: “关切亲属”在旧金山进行抗议，并向媒体、政府官员和国会议员寄送了信件。

sentences.en: They handed out flyers to raise public awareness of the abuses happening in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 他们分发传单，以提高公众对琼斯镇所发生虐待行为的认识。

sentences.en: The flyers read,
sentences.zh: 传单上写着：

sentences.en: This nightmare is taking place right now.
sentences.zh: 这场噩梦此刻正在发生。

sentences.en: Will you help us free our families?
sentences.zh: 你们愿意帮助我们解救我们的家人吗？

sentences.en: We are individuals having only one bond in common.
sentences.zh: 我们是一群只有唯一共同纽带的个体。

sentences.en: Relatives isolated in the Jonestown jungle encampment in Guyana, South America, under the total control of one man,
sentences.zh: 我们的亲人被孤立在南美洲圭亚那的琼斯镇丛林营地中，处于一个人的完全控制之下，

sentences.en: Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: We espouse no political or religious viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 我们不拥护任何政治或宗教观点。

sentences.en: Our only concern is for our families.
sentences.zh: 我们唯一的关切就是我们的家人。

sentences.en: We are bewildered and frightened by what is being done to them.
sentences.zh: 我们对他们所遭受的一切感到困惑和恐惧。

sentences.en: Their human rights are being violated, and the fabric of our family life is being torn apart.
sentences.zh: 他们的人权正在受到侵犯，我们家庭生活的结构正在被撕裂。

sentences.en: Very few Jonestown residents had successfully escaped the commune.
sentences.zh: 极少数琼斯镇居民成功逃离了公社。

sentences.en: Most who did were members of the Jonestown leadership group and were within Jim Jones' inner circle.
sentences.zh: 大多数逃离者都是琼斯镇领导小组成员，属于吉姆·琼斯的核心圈子。

sentences.en: Being trusted by Jones, they had access to the locked away piles of passports and were able to obtain their own before fleeing the commune.
sentences.zh: 由于受到琼斯的信任，他们能够接触到锁起来的护照堆，并在逃离公社前拿回了自己的护照。

sentences.en: Upon their return to America, they were able to publicly detail the conditions in Jonestown and strengthen the claims made by the concerned relatives group.
sentences.zh: 回到美国后，他们得以公开详细说明琼斯镇的情况，并加强了“关切亲属”团体所提出的主张。

sentences.en: On April 11, 1978, the concerned relatives delivered a document titled
sentences.zh: 1978年4月11日，“关切亲属”提交了一份题为

sentences.en: Accusation of Human Rights Violations by Reverend James Warren Jones.
sentences.zh: 《关于詹姆斯·沃伦·琼斯牧师侵犯人权的指控》的文件。

sentences.en: The document attacked Jim Jones directly and outlined the many abuses rampant in Jonestown.
sentences.zh: 该文件直接抨击了吉姆·琼斯，并概述了琼斯镇猖獗的多种虐待行为。

sentences.en: The concerned relatives gave copies of the document to the press and various members of Congress, including Congressman Leo Ryan.
sentences.zh: “关切亲属”将文件副本分发给媒体和多位国会议员，其中包括众议员里奥·瑞安。

sentences.en: Congressman Leo Ryan was a member of the Democratic Party and had served as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 众议员里奥·瑞安是民主党成员，自1973年起担任美国

sentences.en: representative from California's 11th congressional district since 1973.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州第11国会选区的众议员。

sentences.en: A vocal advocate for the often overlooked, less fortunate and poorly treated people within society.
sentences.zh: 他是社会中那些常被忽视、不幸和遭受不公待遇人群的直言不讳的倡导者。

sentences.en: Ryan's hands-on activism made him a standout campaigner.
sentences.zh: 瑞安亲力亲为的行动主义使他成为一名杰出的竞选者。

sentences.en: He was not the type of politician to just sit behind his desk doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 他不是那种只会坐在办公桌后无所作为的政客。

sentences.en: He always carried a strong sense of responsibility to personally help those who couldn't help themselves.
sentences.zh: 他始终怀有强烈的责任感，去亲自帮助那些无法自救的人。

sentences.en: One of Ryan's peers said this about him.
sentences.zh: 瑞安的一位同僚曾这样评价他：

sentences.en: He was accustomed to going into battle.
sentences.zh: 他习惯于冲锋陷阵。

sentences.en: He really felt there was nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 他真的觉得没什么可担心的。

sentences.en: He was a congressman, as if he had some kind of a protective shield.
sentences.zh: 他是一位国会议员，仿佛拥有一种保护盾。

sentences.en: Synonymous with Ryan's name was the word gutsy.
sentences.zh: “勇敢”一词成了瑞安名字的代名词。

sentences.en: He never took no for an answer.
sentences.zh: 他从不接受“不”这个答案。

sentences.en: When he believed in something, no matter how difficult, he never gave up.
sentences.zh: 当他认准某件事时，无论多么困难，他从不放弃。

sentences.en: His unique, head-first style of investigating was given the name of experimental legislating by his peers.
sentences.zh: 他那种独特的、身先士卒的调查风格被同僚们称为“实验性立法”。

sentences.en: Due to his hard-earned political success and respect, in late 1978,
sentences.zh: 由于他来之不易的政治成就和受到的尊重，1978年末，

sentences.en: Congressman Ryan was re-elected for his fourth term in office by a 78-22 majority.
sentences.zh: 瑞安议员以78%对22%的多数票连任第四届任期。

sentences.en: Congressman Ryan had been keeping an eye on news regarding People's Temple and Jim Jones, but had yet to make a move on the matter.
sentences.zh: 瑞安议员一直在关注有关人民圣殿教和吉姆·琼斯的新闻，但尚未就此事采取行动。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Sam Houston, an old friend of Ryan's, contacted the congressman, seeking an investigation into the death of his son, that Leo Ryan stepped in.
sentences.zh: 直到瑞安的老朋友萨姆·休斯顿联系了议员，寻求调查他儿子的死因，里奥·瑞安才介入。

sentences.en: Sam Houston's son was Bob Houston.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·休斯顿的儿子是鲍勃·休斯顿。

sentences.en: Bob was a long-time Temple member whose body was found crushed to death by a train car in San Francisco in October 1976.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃是一名资深的圣殿成员，1976年10月，他的尸体在旧金山被发现，是被火车车厢碾压致死。

sentences.en: Bob's death was ruled a workplace accident, but his work colleagues took issue with that.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃的死被裁定为工伤事故，但他的同事们对此有异议。

sentences.en: Rumors suggested Jim Jones had orchestrated Bob's death.
sentences.zh: 有传言称吉姆·琼斯策划了鲍勃的死亡。

sentences.en: Congressman Ryan agreed to investigate
sentences.zh: 瑞安议员同意调查

sentences.en: People's Temple and Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教和吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: On November 1st, 1978,
Ryan announced plans to travel to Guyana to visit Jonestown on an open and honest fact-finding mission to determine if residents were being held in the commune against their will.
sentences.zh: 瑞安宣布计划前往圭亚那访问琼斯镇，进行一次公开、诚实的实地考察，以确定居民是否违背意愿被扣留在公社中。

sentences.en: He said he would go to Jonestown with or without Jim Jones's permission, and he would stay there for as long as it took to find out what was really going on.
sentences.zh: 他说，无论吉姆·琼斯是否允许，他都会去琼斯镇，并且会一直待在那里，直到查明真相。

sentences.en: Jim Jones believed Ryan's intention was to bring media attention to Jonestown to smear the temple and destroy the church.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯认为瑞安的意图是让媒体关注琼斯镇，从而抹黑圣殿并摧毁教会。

sentences.en: He refused to permit Ryan visitation into Jonestown and sought help from the Guyanese government to refuse Ryan and his delegation into the country at all.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝允许瑞安访问琼斯镇，并寻求圭亚那政府的帮助，以完全拒绝瑞安及其代表团入境。

sentences.en: But he was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 但他失败了。

sentences.en: Jones said, We preferred death to this kind of harassment.

sentences.en: It was eventually agreed that the congressman could enter Jonestown for a few days to interview residents for his investigation.
sentences.zh: 最终达成一致，议员可以进入琼斯镇几天，采访居民进行调查。
